Name: Band Characterization
Description: The BANDSB TRE provides spectroradiometric properties of the sensor system that collected the image in the image segment in which the BANDSB TRE occurs.  The BANDSB TRE describes the measurements and the bands in the image segment, including spatial, spectral, and temporal characteristics.
Notes: The fields APA, APR and APN should loop on <NUM_AUX_B<COUNT>> instead of solely on <NUM_AUX_B>.

COUNT.Name: Number of bands
COUNT.Description: The number of bands comprising the spectral cube.

RADIOMETRIC_QUANTITY.Name: Data Representation
RADIOMETRIC_QUANTITY.Description: This field describes the data held in the image data area of the associated image segment. Values are user-defined, clear text. See field description and NITF Field Value Registry for other possible values.

RADIOMETRIC_QUANTITY_UNIT.Name: Data Representation Unit
RADIOMETRIC_QUANTITY_UNIT.Description: This field describes the unit of measure for the data held in the image data field of the associated image segment.

Values.X: Spectral Emittance and Spectral Irradiance: W m–2 μm–1
Values.S: Spectral Radiance: W m–2 sr–1 μm–1
Values.I: Thermal Inertia and Apparent Thermal Inertia: J m–2 s–1/2 K–1

SCALE_FACTOR.Name: Cube Scale Factor (M)
SCALE_FACTOR.Description: This field describes the multiplicative factor applied to all bands of the data cube.  This is applied after any individual band adjustments or scaling and before data were stored in the image data of the image segment.

ADDITIVE_FACTOR.Name: Cube Additive Factor
ADDITIVE_FACTOR.Description: The constant (A) added to all bands of the data cube after the multiplicative factor was applied. The stored value = A + Mx.

ROW_GSD.Name: Row Ground Sample Distance
ROW_GSD.Description: The values in this field describe the nominal row spacing, or spacing between rows, measured as pixel center to pixel center. Distance on the ground between centers of corresponding pixels of adjacent rows, i.e., two adjacent pixels in the same column, in meters; or Angular center-to-center distance (pitch) between corresponding pixels of adjacent rows measured in microradians.

ROW_GSD_UNIT.Name: The unit of Row Ground Sample Distance
ROW_GSD_UNIT.Description: This field describes the unit of measure for the data in ROW_GSD.

COL_GSD.Name: Column Ground Sample Distance
COL_GSD.Description: The values in this field describe the nominal column spacing, or spacing between columns, measured as pixel center to pixel center. Distance on the ground between the centers of corresponding pixels of adjacent columns, i.e., two adjacent pixels in the same row, in meters; or Angular center-to-center distance (pitch) between corresponding pixels of adjacent columns measured in microradians.

COL_GSD_UNIT.Name: The unit of Column Ground Sample Distance
COL_GSD_UNIT.Description: This field describes the unit of measure for the data in COL_GSD.

SPT_RESP_ROW.Name: The spatial Response Function across Rows
SPT_RESP_ROW.Description: This field describes the nominal pixel/detector, size measured perpendicular to data row.

SPT_RESP_UNIT_ROW.Name: Unit of Row Spatial Response
SPT_RESP_UNIT_ROW.Description: This field describes the unit of measure for the data in SPT_RESP_ROW.

SPT_RESP_COL.Name: Spatial Response Function across Columns
SPT_RESP_COL.Description: This field describes the nominal pixel/detector size, measured perpendicular to data column.

SPT_RESP_UNIT_COL.Name: Unit of Row Spatial Response
SPT_RESP_UNIT_COL.Description: This field describes the unit of measure used for the data in SPT_RESP_COL.

DATA_FLD_1.Name: Reserved for future use
DATA_FLD_1.Description: This field is reserved for use in the future.

EXISTENCE_MASK.Name: The bit-wise Existence Mask Field
EXISTENCE_MASK.Description: The 32 flags represented by the bits of this 4-byte (32 bit) field (b31, b30, b29, b28 through b2, b1, b0). A bit set to zero signals that a conditional field is not present in this extension. A bit set to the value one indicates the inclusion of the conditional field.

RADIOMETRIC_ADJUSTMENT_SURFACE.Name: Adjustment Surface
RADIOMETRIC_ADJUSTMENT_SURFACE.Description: The presence of this field indicates that radiometric adjustments have been done to the associated spectral cube. This field shall indicate the surface to which radiometric adjustment has been done.

ATMOSPHERIC_ADJUSTMENT_ALTITUDE.Name: Altitude Above WGS 84 Ellipsoid
ATMOSPHERIC_ADJUSTMENT_ALTITUDE.Description: This field contains a valid value when the Radiometric Adjustment Surface field indicates within atmosphere; otherwise a NaN (not a number) value.

DIAMETER.Name: Diameter of the lens
DIAMETER.Description: This represents the diameter of the lens in centimeters.

DATA_FLD_2.Name: Reserved for future use
DATA_FLD_2.Description: This field is reserved for use in the future.

WAVE_LENGTH_UNIT.Name: Wavelength Unit
WAVE_LENGTH_UNIT.Description: This field describes the unit of measure for subsequent wavelength fields.

BANDID<COUNT>.Name: Band Identifier
BANDID<COUNT>.Description: This is a unique identifier that represents the nth band of the associated spectral cube.

BAD_BAND<COUNT>.Name: Bad Band Flag
BAD_BAND<COUNT>.Description: The numeric field that signals the validity of the nth band of the associated spectral cube. Exploitation results including one or more bad bands may not be valid. 0 = Invalid, bad, suspect or corrupted data in the nth band. 1 = nth band contains valid data.

NIIRS<COUNT>.Name: NIIRS Value
NIIRS<COUNT>.Description: The MS/HS NIIRS rating for the nth band. If NIIRSn is unknown for for the nth band, then NIIRSn shall be --- (hyphen-minus characters). If NIIRSn for the nth band is greater than 9.9, then NIIRSn shall be +++.

FOCAL_LEN<COUNT>.Name: Band Focal Length
FOCAL_LEN<COUNT>.Description: This field contains the focal length of the detector or optics for the nth band of the associated spectral cube.

CWAVE<COUNT>.Name: Band Center Response Wavelength
CWAVE<COUNT>.Description: The wavelength or wavenumber at the center of a detector's band profile. This field is only used in conjunction with symmetrical (e.g. Gaussian), band profiles.

FWHM<COUNT>.Name: Band Width
FWHM<COUNT>.Description: The wavelength difference between the upper and lower bounds at the 50% (-3 dB) points of the sensor spectral response.

FWHM_UNC<COUNT>.Name: Band Width Uncertainty
FWHM_UNC<COUNT>.Description: This field describes the uncertainty of the wavelength described in the FWHM field.

NOM_WAVE<COUNT>.Name: Nominal Wavelength
NOM_WAVE<COUNT>.Description: This field describes how the nominal wavelength is defined.  For asymmetric band profile distributions, this value will be the median wavelength of which equal amounts of energy are captured above and below this nominal wavelength.

NOM_WAVE_UNC<COUNT>.Name: Nominal Wavelength Uncertainty
NOM_WAVE_UNC<COUNT>.Description: This field describes the uncertainty of the nominal wavelength described in the NOM_WAVE field.

LBOUND<COUNT>.Name: Band Lower Wavelength Bound
LBOUND<COUNT>.Description: The wavelength for the nth band at the lower 50% (-3 dB) point of the sensor spectral response.

UBOUND<COUNT>.Name: Band Upper Wavelength Bound
UBOUND<COUNT>.Description: The wavelength for the nth band at the upper 50% (-3 dB) point of the sensor spectral response.

SCALE_FACTOR<COUNT>.Name: Individual Scale Factor (M sub n)
SCALE_FACTOR<COUNT>.Description: The multiplicative factor applied to nth band of the spectral cube before it was stored in the data area of the associated image segment.

ADDITIVE_FACTOR<COUNT>.Name: Individual Additive Factor (A sub n)
ADDITIVE_FACTOR<COUNT>.Description: This field describes the constant added to nth band of the spectral cube before it was stored in the data area of the associated image segment and after multiplicative factor was applied.

START_TIME<COUNT>.Name: Start Time
START_TIME<COUNT>.Description: The starting time and date that the nth band was collected, expressed in UTC, Zulu time zone. If portions of this date and time are unknown, implementers will place hyphen-minus (0x2D) characters in the unknown portions of the START_TIMEn field.

INT_TIME<COUNT>.Name: Integration Time
INT_TIME<COUNT>.Description: This field contains the total number of milliseconds taken to collect the band.

CALDRK<COUNT>.Name: Band Calibration (Dark)
CALDRK<COUNT>.Description: The calibrated receive power for the nth band that corresponds to a pixel value of 0. CALDRKn is essentially the mean power level with the shutter closed. (Compare CALDRKn to the related BKNOISEn field).

CALIBRATION_SENSITIVITY<COUNT>.Name: Band Calibration (Increment)
CALIBRATION_SENSITIVITY<COUNT>.Description: The mean change in power level for the nth band that corresponds to an increase of 1 in pixel value.

ROW_GSD<COUNT>.Name: Band Spatial Response Interval by Row
ROW_GSD<COUNT>.Description: This field describes the spacing between rows of the nth band. Ground distance between centers of corresponding pixels of adjacent rows, i.e., adjacent pixels in the same column, in meters; or Angular center-to-center distance (pitch), of the nth band, between corresponding pixels of adjacent rows measured in microradians.

ROW_GSD_UNC<COUNT>.Name: Band Spatial Response Interval Uncertainty by Row
ROW_GSD_UNC<COUNT>.Description: This field contains the uncertainty in the value reported in the field ROW_GSD, the spacing between pixels of adjacent rows.

ROW_GSD_UNIT<COUNT>.Name: Unit of Row Spacing
ROW_GSD_UNIT<COUNT>.Description: This field describes the units used for ROW_GSD and ROW_GSD_UNC.

COL_GSD<COUNT>.Name: Band Spatial Response Interval by Column
COL_GSD<COUNT>.Description: This field describes the spacing between columns of the nth band. Ground distance between centers of corresponding pixels of adjacent columns, i.e., adjacent pixels in the same row, in meters; or Angular center-to-center distance (pitch), of the nth band, between corresponding pixels of adjacent columns measured in microradians.

COL_GSD_UNC<COUNT>.Name: Band Spatial Response Interval Uncertainty Column
COL_GSD_UNC<COUNT>.Description: This field contains the uncertainty in the value reported in the field COL_GSD, spacing between pixels of adjacent columns.

COL_GSD_UNIT<COUNT>.Name: Unit of Column Spacing
COL_GSD_UNIT<COUNT>.Description: This field describes the units used for COL_GSD and COL_GSD_UNC.

BKNOISE<COUNT>.Name: Band Background Noise
BKNOISE<COUNT>.Description: This field describes the measured noise level of the collection system with the shutter closed.

SCNNOISE<COUNT>.Name: Band Scene Noise
SCNNOISE<COUNT>.Description: The noise equivalent target of the scene. Noise level for a Signal-to-Noise Ratio of 1. BKNOISE is the variation about the mean value of the power level, CALDRK. BKNOISE which is commonly calculated as the standard deviation of the power level when the shutter is closed. (Compare BKNOISE to the related CALDRKn field).

SPT_RESP_FUNCTION_ROW<COUNT>.Name: Band Spatial Response Function across Rows
SPT_RESP_FUNCTION_ROW<COUNT>.Description: The pixel/detector coverage measured at FWHM perpendicular to data rows. This is the instantaneous field of view (IFOV) for the across row direction.

SPT_RESP_UNC_ROW<COUNT>.Name: Band Spatial Response Function Uncertainty
SPT_RESP_UNC_ROW<COUNT>.Description: This field contains the uncertainty in the value reported in the field SPT_RESP_FUNCTION_ROW.

SPT_RESP_UNIT_ROW<COUNT>.Name: Unit of Row Spatial Response
SPT_RESP_UNIT_ROW<COUNT>.Description: This field describes the units used for the previous two fields: SPT_RESP_FUNCTION_ROW and SPT_RESP UNC_ROW.

SPT_RESP_FUNCTION_COL<COUNT>.Name: Band Spatial Response Function across Columns
SPT_RESP_FUNCTION_COL<COUNT>.Description: The pixel/detector coverage measured at FWHM perpendicular to data columns. This is the instantaneous field of view (IFOV) for the across column direction.

SPT_RESP_UNC_COL<COUNT>.Name: Band Spatial Response Function Uncertainty
SPT_RESP_UNC_COL<COUNT>.Description: This field contains the uncertainty in the value reported in the field SPT_RESP_FUNCTION_COL.

SPT_RESP_UNIT_COL<COUNT>.Name: Unit of Column Spatial Response
SPT_RESP_UNIT_COL<COUNT>.Description: This field describes the units for the previous two fields: SPT_RESP_FUNCTION_COL and SPT_RESP_UNC_COL.

DATA_FLD_3<COUNT>.Name: This field is reserved for future use
DATA_FLD_3<COUNT>.Description: This field reserved for use in the future.

DATA_FLD_4<COUNT>.Name: Field reserved for future use
DATA_FLD_4<COUNT>.Description: This Field is reserved for use in the future.

DATA_FLD_5<COUNT>.Name: This field is reserved for future use
DATA_FLD_5<COUNT>.Description: This field reserved for use in the future.

DATA_FLD_6<COUNT>.Name: Field reserved for future use
DATA_FLD_6<COUNT>.Description: This Field is reserved for use in the future.

NUM_AUX_B.Name: The number of Auxiliary Band Level Parameters (m)
NUM_AUX_B.Description: This series of parameters has values specified for each band held in the image product.

NUM_AUX_C.Name: The number of Auxiliary Cube Level Parameters (k)
NUM_AUX_C.Description: This series of parameters values are specified once for the entire image spectral cube.

BAPF<NUM_AUX_B>.Name: Band Auxiliary Parameter Value Format
BAPF<NUM_AUX_B>.Description: The APNmn, APRmn and APAmn fields are required when BAPFm value is respectively I, R and A.

UBAP<NUM_AUX_B>.Name: Unit of Band Auxiliary Parameter
UBAP<NUM_AUX_B>.Description: This is the unit of Band Auxiliary Parameter.

APN<NUM_AUX_B>.Name: Auxiliary Parameter Integer Value
APN<NUM_AUX_B>.Description: This number represents integer values for the auxiliary parameter.

APR<NUM_AUX_B>.Name: Auxiliary Parameter Real Value
APR<NUM_AUX_B>.Description: This number represents real values for the auxiliary parameter.

APA<NUM_AUX_B>.Name: Auxiliary Parameter Character String Value
APA<NUM_AUX_B>.Description: This string represents alpha values for the auxiliary parameter.

CAPF<NUM_AUX_C>.Name: Auxiliary Parameter Value Format
CAPF<NUM_AUX_C>.Description: The APNk, APRk and APAk fields are required when CAPFk value is respectively I, R and A.

UCAP<NUM_AUX_C>.Name: Unit of Cube Auxiliary Parameter
UCAP<NUM_AUX_C>.Description: This is the unit of the Cube Auxiliary Parameter.

APN<NUM_AUX_C>.Name: Auxiliary Parameter Integer Value
APN<NUM_AUX_C>.Description: This is the value that represents the Auxiliary Parameter.

APR<NUM_AUX_C>.Name: Auxiliary Parameter Real Value
APR<NUM_AUX_C>.Description: This is the real value of the auxiliary parameter.

APA<NUM_AUX_C>.Name: Auxiliary Parameter Character String Value
APA<NUM_AUX_C>.Description: This is the character string value of the auxiliary parameter.
